## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue or parity item when relevant.

## Evidence and sources

For behavior changes, describe the independent expectation and observed RED/GREEN results.
Link public sources and record provenance in the repository when relevant.
For UI changes, include the native workflow checked, platform and evidence.

## Validation

List the exact commands, results and platforms. Explain checks you could not run.
Documentation-only changes can use relevant link or configuration checks.
See the [contribution guide](https://github.com/thematheusmello/bondline/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup and required code gates.

## Limits and risks

State remaining unsupported behavior, data-preservation risks or platform gaps.
Distinguish what is wired from what is verified.

## Review checklist

Mark items that apply; explain anything not applicable.

- [ ] Relevant tests, source records and documentation accompany the change.
- [ ] New dependencies, assets and fixtures meet the license policy and retain notices.
- [ ] No credentials, disposable research files, caches or build outputs are included.
- [ ] Any change to an approved golden has renewed human approval.
